text: Absolutely an positive experience.  I went in with a very painful ear infection. They did a thorough check before making their recommendation.  They treated me with so much care and kindness. I felt in such a safe and comfortable space. All services (IV, injections, tests, etc) were top notch. All prescriptions were clearly explained in English and all information was provided. They requested that I return (at no cost) so doctor could ensure Im improving. Wow! Thank you to the staff at the clinic. I am grateful.

I came here with a really bad ear infection right after arriving in Koh Samui and received excellent care.

All the staff and nurses were kind and professional, and the doctor was incredibly caring, patient, and thorough. She explained everything clearly, walked me through the treatment options, and made me feel confident and safe from the very first moment.

They performed an ear flush, cleaned everything carefully then injected steroids and showed me each step along the way.

After just one day I already feel much better and I’m continuing the treatment feeling very reassured. I even shared the doctor’s report with my own doctor back home, a renowned and very critical specialist, and she confirmed that everything was done correctly, that “I was in good hands” which gave me even more peace of mind.

Lastly, the medical report they provided is very detailed and will be excellent for my insurance claim.

Overall, I’m extremely happy with the experience and highly recommend this clinic.

Great and fast walk-in service.

I had an earinfection and got help fast.

The staff is great and professional.

All the medicine is recieved on spot and they fill in proper paperwork for insurance.

Higly reccommended

Such lovely and professional people!
All personal were kind, helpful and fair.
They listen thoroughly to what I said, and gave me the most experienced and thoughtful answers and solutions.
If you are sick - this is the place you want to get treated at.

I fell ill whilst in Bangkok and it didn’t improve when I arrived in Koh Samui. My hotel called this clinic out to come and see me and they were absolutely amazing! The best service I have ever experienced

I went to this clinic when feeling very unwell with a bad case of the flu I presumed. They were very unhelpful. There was No air conditioning! They then tried getting me to pay 2200 for a covid test. When I refused they started being rude and irate. Please please do not go here for any sort of medical treatment

I've got stomach flu on my 4th day of my trip. Worrying I might be too weak to travel back home on the 5th day, I decided to engage Doctor Samui through whatsapp. They responded quickly and asked about my symptoms and the hotel I am staying. They were at my doorstep in less than an hour. 1 doctor and 2 other staff came. They spoke good English. They gave me IV drip, took my blood, administer antibiotics and other medications on the spot. The 2 staff stayed until my IV drip finished and gave me clear instructions on the oral medications for the next few days.

I felt assured that someone came and took care of me and gave me proper medication (Before engaging them, I did buy some off the shelf medication but didn't work).

They whatsapp me the doctor's memo and receipt (in English) and couple of hours later, they sent me the blood test results. This whole service is really expensive but luckily I bought travel insurance.

All in all, I think their service is really good and gave me reassurance. Highly recommend anyone out there who need a doctor to see you urgently.

To Doctor Samui team: Thank you for coming to Holiday Inn Bophut to "rescue" me on 23 Dec 2024. I was too sick to remember your names otherwise I will list them all here.
Great service, very nice people and super helpful. They were in 30 minutes in our hotel. Of course it is pricey but worth it if needed.

We do not recommend this clinic to other tourists.

We visited for an acute digestive illness (vomiting, diarrhea). No clear diagnosis was provided, yet multiple tests and heavy treatments were proposed without proper medical explanation.

An IV infusion with several medications (including antibiotics) was immediately offered for 25,000 baht, without clearly justifying why such treatment was necessary.

We felt that financial considerations were prioritized over appropriate medical care.

Although an initial diagnostic fee of 1,000 baht was mentioned, we were eventually charged 4,000 baht, while leaving with many unanswered questions.

The patient improved naturally with rest and oral hydration, which further questioned the relevance of the proposed treatments.

As tourists, this experience felt stressful, expensive, and lacking transparency.

I had an excellent experience at this clinic.
The staff was professional, kind, and very attentive to my needs.
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone seeking medical care in Thailand.

Every staff member was very friendly and helpful. I went there in order to take out my 7 stitches and paid 700 baht, which is a great price. There was an option to pay by card too. I would 100% recommend this place over other hospitals.

I’m forever grateful for the service we received at this clinic today I wasn’t sure how well it would go. My son suffers from a chronic arthritis and experienced a huge flare up whilst visiting Thailand who could barely walk he was in so much pain. We were in and out of the clinic within the hour, the staff and doctor were extremely helpful and caring and knew how to help instantly. My son was given a medicine injection to help relieve his symptoms and we are now back at our apartment resting. As a mother I feel utter relief. Thank you

I recently visited Dr. Samui Clinic due to a painful uterine infection, and the care I received was truly exceptional. Dr. Saranya Choonhachai was professional, compassionate, and incredibly thorough in diagnosing and treating my condition. I also want to highlight the excellent care provided by the Male nurse, whose kindness and attentiveness made me feel truly cared for throughout the process. The clinic itself was clean and welcoming, and the entire team ensured I was comfortable and informed every step of the way. Thanks to their outstanding care, I’m already feeling much better. I highly recommend Dr. Samui Clinic to anyone seeking top-quality medical care!

I ve been there because of a simple diarrhea. The doctor spoke 5 minutes to me, the nurses gave me 5 different medications. 9250 Baht. Some people would call that unbelievable expensive, other might call that cheating.

This clinic is exceptional. My daughter became unwell shortly before we had a long flight back to the UK, and the doctor visited us in our hotel to examine and give treatment. A further visit was made to give more treatment, all of which meant our daughter recovered quickly and in time for the flight home. The fact you can contact the Dr and get an immediate response 24/7 is exceptional. Everyone is very professional, knowledgeable and caring. I would highly recommend.

The Dr. Saranya Choonhachai is a very nice and lovely person.
Her assistants were also very kind.

They came to my hotel room and helped me directly with my heavy sunburn. An IV was given to me directly at the hotel room.

Would contact the clinic the next time, if I need some medical advice or help.

Update: It wasn't a sunburn, at the second visit from the doctor we found out, that it was COVID-19. 😅 I would recommend the doctor, since she helped me to recover in 4 days, after we found out

Thanks!

Excellent service, we arrived in Koh Samui with two teenagers who were not feeling well, we contacted our travel insurance,that contacted us to samui clinic, the clinic team arrived at the hotel. The staff was professional and gave detailed explanations and were in touch throughout, even after a few days, to see that everything was okay. Thank you

If you need clinical help, please go to this place. The doctors and nurses are extremely helpful, friendly and professional. They also accept Card Payment/Apple Pay and will not charge you anything before telling you.

I recently used Dr. Samui Clinic while staying in Koh Samui, and I cannot recommend them highly enough.
Dr. Chotika, together with staff members Bussra and Wuddy, came directly to my hotel room when I was suffering from a urinary tract infection.

They provided excellent service: a thorough physical examination, an on-site urine test, and clear explanations throughout. I was given the appropriate antibiotics, and just a few hours later they sent me the detailed lab results.

The entire experience was professional, efficient, and very caring. The team was kind, attentive, and made me feel comfortable and well looked after.
If you ever need medical care in Samui, I strongly recommend Dr. Samui Clinic for their outstanding service and professionalism.

We had an excellent experience with this clinic. My son had a severe ear infection. We reached out and shortly after the doctor and two nurses came to our hotel room and treated him wonderfully and very professionally. After a few days he …

I had a very good experience there after suffering chronic neck and back pain. Dr Mint took good care of me and when my body didn't respond to pain medication, she made few phone calls and booked appointment for me to a physiotherapist. They even didn't charge me for that follow up visit. Highly recommend this place if you are in Samui.
This place is very good, works quickly, the doctor gives good advice, speaks well, service is like royalty. And the clinic is open 24 hours if you are sick at any time. I recommend coming here.

Great service. We left a WhatsApp message at 4:30am and they responded 30 minutes later. The doctor was on an emergency call so they couldn’t come immediately but did arrive 2 hours later. Came right to the hotel with a nurse. Did multiple tests, and had all the medication on hand. Wasn’t cheap but not unreasonable considering the service provided… plus they provide documentation for travel insurance. Also the follow up was great. Contacted us 36 hours later to see how the treatment was progressing. Would recommend highly. This was for a case of influenza and bronchitis. They had all the appropriate tests on hand.  Very efficient and professional. Thank you!

I couldn’t hear out of my right ear. I went to a local pharmacy who suggested I come to this clinic. The doctor and nurses were wonderful and after a long careful examination and procedure, I was able to hear again after all wax was removed.

My experience at clinic was mixed. On the one hand, I felt welcomed, and the clinic itself seemed professional. However, the doctor who treated me turned out to be completely incompetent.

I was dealing with a severe bacterial infection and had already completed a five-day course of antibiotics. Unfortunately, as soon as I finished the treatment, my symptoms returned even worse than before. At this clinic, I was prescribed a ten-day course of what I thought was a different antibiotic. Only later did I realize that it was actually the same medication, just under a different name.

Once again, the treatment only provided temporary relief but did not cure the infection. On the eighth day of taking the second antibiotic, my symptoms returned in full force. It was only when I was admitted to a hospital that I discovered I had been given the same ineffective antibiotic twice. There, I finally received the correct medication, and after just one day, I felt significantly better.

Had I been properly diagnosed and treated from the start, I could have enjoyed my vacation much more. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic for serious medical issues.

Cannot recommend this clinic enough. The doctors and nurses were wonderful, spoke great English, were completely transparent with prices and processes, transferred me to and from radiology, were kind and patient, and sent my results and checked in on me a few days later. 800 baht fee to see the doctor, and the team ask before charging for anything further to ensure you understand. I sent my friend a few days later and they were just as excellent. Thank you!

Had an accident and the hospital were charging exorbitant prices to get my cleaned and redressed. Pang and Am were so kind to me and really took time to care for me 💖 if you need medical assistance don’t look any further. …

We had four staff members from Doctor Samui visit us in our hotel room to provide my husband with a consultation after 24 hours of severe sickness. They provided us with medications, took some samples for pathology and administered an IV …
Very professional staff. I was very impressed with their skills and great customer service. if you have a medical problem on Koh Smui these guys are highly recommended.  100%. David. NZ

Amazing experience with their healthcare team. My husband was unable to keep anything down and they arrived within 40 minutes to administer fluids and antibiotics by IV at our hotel. He was in no shape to go to them. The follow up care with additional IV medication as well as communication in what’s app was incredible.  So glad we went this route. Forever grateful we will be able to continue on our vacation with only a brief hiccup. Thanks so much for being able to get my husband back on his feet. Being able to communicate in English with English instructions on the medications was very helpful. Kind, thorough and professional. Five stars!!! 👍

The clinic staff was just wonderful! My friend and I needed wound dressing everyday and they took very good care of us. They cleaned the wounds better than the hospital we had to go right after the accident and were really careful while cleaning. The prices are totally fine but the best thing was really how nice they were. One day they even drove us to a dinner place they recommended us after we asked them 😄

Amazing, doctors and nurses were all so kind and friendly. Went in after having a fever for a week. Diagnosed me quickly after a few blood tests and had me back to good health in only three days! Definitely a very professional clinic, with people who know what they’re doing. Would recommend to everyone.

I became incredibly ill on Koh Samui and the clinic was available around the clock and made several home visits to our hotel to provide me with care. I felt incredibly well looked after and quickly got better!

I got very sick on Samui with very high fevers. We did not trust it and called the doctor. They made a visit to the hotel within 45 minutes. They started treatment immediately and got me the right medications. …

I contacted Doctor Samui clinic via WhatsApp and they came to our hotel because my daughter wasn’t well enough to go to the clinic. The staff took excellent care of her and followed up through WhatsApp. They provided information and instructions in English which was very much appreciated.

My partner and I were sick and we called a doctor through them, a team of a doctor and two nurses arrived, excellent care, they were all lovely and took care of us in the best way, really 100/100. Professional, caring and pleasant

Excellent service received. Was seen super quickly and efficiently. Friendly staff. I had first degree sunburn and was very poorly, the treatment and medication I received saved my holiday. I am very grateful to all the staff who helped me
Needed a rabies booster, they speak English and charge a normal price (1.500 baht all in). They are friendly and they helped me quickly.

Yesterday I visited a clinic in Ko Samui together with my wife and daughter. My wife had severe back pain, I had a rash, and my daughter was suffering from ear pain. From the very first moment, the doctor and clinic team welcomed us warmly.

Dr. Saranya is extremely professional and knowledgeable. She quickly understood each of our issues, clearly explained the options along with their pros and cons, and prescribed the right medicines.

Today, we all feel much better. This is truly a great clinic in Ko Samui with an outstanding doctor that we highly recommend!

The practice is very professional and clean. The staff are very delicate and caring to treat wounds and remove stitches. The cost is also a lot less than the hospitals. Highly recommend. I’m from London and live in Australia and the standards are very high. Staff names are Male and natty - both excellent

Yesterday my boyfriend and I came to this clinic after feeling poorly for several days.
We were seen immediately and made comfortable in a private room. They ran some …

My son contracted food poisoning and was getting worse by the hour. He had just broken his leg and couldn't get around easily. I contacted the clinic over WhatsApp and got an instant reply. Communication was very good and I had a Dr and 2 nurses arrive in approximately 90min. They were very professional and effective. I got a full explanation of what they were doing and why. The Dr explained her treatment plan fully. One nurse stayed for 2.5 hours to oversee the administration of an IV. They really eased my mind and took complete control. I was very happy I called them.

Amazing people and service. I’ve been to clinic three times, with rabies thing and wound cleaning. Everything went super fast and nicely. Doctors and nurses are extremely kind. Even with me being so stressed out and asking million questions they helped me with each of them. I absolutely recommend this clinic. Than you for your help!

Needed to visit due to an eye issue and was seen very quickly. Staff were very accommodating and professional. I was seen and treated very quickly and sent on my way with prescriptions required for ongoing treatment.

I texted the clinic regarding an issue with my ears and within an hour a doctor and two nurses were at my condo to provide treatment. They were very professional, friendly and had all the necessary equipment to diagnose the problem and …
Brilliant clinic. Went there to remove 12 stitches at 10 pm. Took 15 minutes all together. Fair price!

I became very ill when I arrived to koh samui, I had been vomiting from 3am - 12pm and getting weaker as the time went on, two doctors arrived at my hotel and did a full assessment, they treated me with antibiotics, drips and anything else that was needed in my hotel room. The two ladies were so kind and helpful. I instantly felt better and was giving antibiotics and other tablets to take over the next few days. They did blood samples which showed I had a bacterial infection.

I was severely sick with a high fever. A doctor came out immediately and confirmed I had influenza A. She recommended an IV drip which helped alleviate my high fever and made me feel better. So glad I contacted them. I hope I’ll be able to enjoy the rest of my vacation
Had a great experience with Doctor Samui Clinic. We had them visit our apartment when my husband was sick and in bed with a high fever. …
I wish to thank Samui Clinic for the professional and kind treatment I have received. I hope you will not need it, but in case you do you will be in very good hands.
Open 8-24 - there is no 24 hour Service
Professional clinic, kind attitude, simply amazing
No appointment necessary, cool and professional service, reasonable price

After three days of initial vomiting and recurring diarrhea, my boyfriend and I went to the clinic. The trip from Bophut Beach was definitely worth it. An extremely caring doctor and nurse performed blood and stool tests, gave me an IV, and provided medication and the test results. There was no waiting time, and the treatment was first-class. Of course, this service isn't exactly cheap, but it was absolutely worth it!
Fast helpful and knowledgeable. I would recommend them. The nurse was incredibly kind.

Excellent staff.
We went for treatment of a hand wound, and they handled everything perfectly.
For 5 dressings and bandages on 5 different days, a tetanus vaccine, antibiotic cream, a doctor's visit, and a course of antibiotics and oral anti-inflammatory medication, the total cost was about €200, which we had reimbursed by our insurance.
Super sweet nurses. They do their work carefully and make sure you leave feeling good.
Amazing doctor, excellent treatment

Tourists are being ripped off here. Rabies vaccination cost 3500 baht plus the doctor's fee. Then they mistakenly insisted on 5 sessions instead of 2 to make even more money. In another clinic, we paid 800 baht for the vaccine. Pure robbery!
Excellent welcome and top-notch care from a very friendly and competent nurse!
Absolutely top-notch professional

We received great service from them. Once they came to them and once they visited us at the hotel. They came with a full team. They worked quietly and efficiently. They were very nice. They took measurements, examined and gave treatment on …
I received excellent care from a team of nurses who welcomed me with a gentle and sweet smile, including doctors Pang and Dr. Cream.

The consultation lasted barely 2 minutes. I explained my problem: a history of skin cancer. The doctor didn't even examine the painful area closely. I left 10 minutes later with a baby moisturizer and 1300 pounds lighter. Much more expensive than other clinics here. Maybe I just went on a bad day... there was no one else there, though.

Drive there, no waiting time, quick vital signs check including blood pressure and temperature. Then a consultation with the doctor, immediate dispensing of all medications – it couldn't be better. Lab results are sent via email and WhatsApp. Prices are completely reasonable (less than €100 including antibiotics and tablets). It's never pleasant to need medical help on vacation, but if you do, this is the place to go. I wholeheartedly recommend them!

Thanks to the team on site for the prompt assistance!
Excellent care very nice and kind doctors

The advice you receive is excellent. There's no waiting time, and both the nurses and the doctor take a great deal of time to explain everything in detail. I can highly recommend this clinic! You won't find this kind of service in Germany.

text: The entire medical crew is very professional, thorough, gentle and kind!
